statutory_group_instance_no_slot: This form prints {count} {group} slots, and this is one more.
statutory_group_instance_goes_to: It will be written into {destination} instead. Nothing is lost, but it will read as a note rather than a filled box.
statutory_revision_soon: Revision {version} replaces this form on {date}. This inspection is dated {inspectionDate} and is not affected; inspections dated on or after {date} need the updated template.
statutory_revision_superseded_elsewhere: Revision {version} took effect on {date}. This inspection is dated {inspectionDate}, so it is still produced from the earlier revision — that is correct, and nothing needs to change here.
statutory_revision_cannot_produce: This inspection is dated {inspectionDate}, which falls under revision {applicable}. This template produces revision {template}, so this form cannot be produced for this inspection. Ask an administrator to update the template, then start this inspection again on the updated one.
statutory_template_retired_superseded: Replaced by a newer revision on {date} — no longer available for new inspections.
statutory_template_retired_uninstalled: Uninstalled on {date} — ask an administrator to reinstall it.
statutory_update_none_blocked: None of them is dated under the newer revision, so this update costs nothing that is already under way.
statutory_update_none_inflight: No inspection is in progress on this template, so this update changes nothing already under way.
statutory_update_confirm_error: Couldn't read what this update would affect. Nothing has been changed.
statutory_update_inflight_one: 1 of {total} inspections in progress stays on revision {version} and still produces its form — its date falls inside that revision's window.
statutory_update_inflight_many: {producible} of {total} inspections in progress stay on revision {version} and still produce their form — their dates fall inside its window.
statutory_update_blocked_one: 1 of them is dated under revision {version} and cannot produce the form at all. It has to be started again on the updated template.
statutory_update_blocked_many: {count} of them are dated under revision {version} and cannot produce the form at all. Those have to be started again on the updated template.
statutory_revision_withdrawn_field_map: Revision {version} was withdrawn on {date}: a defect was found in this software's map of where each answer prints on that form. This inspection, dated {inspectionDate}, cannot produce the form until a corrected map arrives in a software update, and every copy already produced from revision {version} should be produced again once it does. Nothing else needs changing here — the correction comes from us.
statutory_revision_withdrawn_field_map_r: Revision {version} was withdrawn on {date}: a defect was found in this software's map of where each answer prints on that form. Revision {replacement} governs this inspection, dated {inspectionDate} — ask an administrator to update the template, then start this inspection again on the updated one. Every copy already produced from revision {version} should be produced again.
statutory_revision_withdrawn_authority: The authority withdrew revision {version} on {date}, so this form is no longer produced from it. No software update will bring it back, so there is nothing to wait for. This deployment publishes no other revision covering {inspectionDate}: the form now required has to be obtained from the authority.
statutory_revision_withdrawn_authority_r: The authority withdrew revision {version} on {date}, so this form is no longer produced from it. No software update will bring it back: revision {replacement} is the one in force for this inspection, dated {inspectionDate}. Ask an administrator to update the template, then start this inspection again on the updated one.
statutory_update_withdrawn_field_map: Revision {version}, the one this workspace's template still produces, was withdrawn: a defect was found in this software's map of where each answer prints on that form. Updating is the right move. Inspections still on the withdrawn revision have to be started again on the updated template, and copies already produced from revision {version} should be produced again.
statutory_update_withdrawn_authority: Revision {version}, the one this workspace's template still produces, was withdrawn by the authority. No software update will bring it back, so updating is the only way forward. Inspections still on the withdrawn revision have to be started again on the updated template.
statutory_update_withdrawn_inflight_one: 1 inspection in progress is still on revision {version} and can no longer produce its form.
statutory_update_withdrawn_inflight_many: {count} inspections in progress are still on revision {version} and can no longer produce their form.
statutory_readiness_title: Could a job booked today produce these?
statutory_readiness_subtitle: Three things have to be true, and they belong to three different people. This is the only screen that can show all three at once.
statutory_readiness_no_revision: No revision of this form is in force today, so it cannot be produced whatever else is set up.
statutory_readiness_who: The template is installed from the marketplace by an administrator; the PDF is supplied above, by an owner; the licence class is typed by each inspector under Settings → Profile.
statutory_source_subtitle: A statutory form is printed onto the issuing authority's own published document, and that document is not shipped with this software. Supply it here, once per revision. Each file is checked against the sha256 the revision records before anything is stored.
statutory_source_no_storage: This deployment has no object storage bound, so an uploaded file has nowhere to go. Bind a bucket before uploading — nothing on this page can succeed until then.
statutory_source_load_failed_hint: Uploading is still possible, but what is already stored could not be read.
statutory_source_empty_title: This build publishes no statutory forms
statutory_source_empty_desc: There is nothing to supply. A statutory revision arrives with a software update, together with the map of where each answer prints on the form — it cannot be added from here.
statutory_source_absent_detail: Nothing is stored for this revision, so a template built for it installs but produces nothing.
statutory_source_dates_mandatory_until: In use from {from}, required from {mandatory}, until {until}
statutory_source_no_file: The revision is printed on the document itself — check it before uploading.
statutory_source_ok: Stored. Revision {revision} of {formId} can be produced now.
statutory_source_failed: The upload was refused and nothing was stored.
statutory_details_subtitle: These boxes are printed on the authority's form and are asked for nowhere else, so they appear only on inspections that produce one.
statutory_details_signature_date_hint: The day you sign the form, which is not the day of the visit — the form prints both.
statutory_details_employee_name_hint: The second signer some forms print beside yours. Leave it empty if the form you produce has no such box.
statutory_details_owner_group_hint: The person who OWNS the property, who is often not the client — a buyer commissions the inspection and the seller owns the house. Nothing here is filled in from the client on purpose.
statutory_details_owner_mailing_address_: Where the owner receives post, which may not be the property.
